{{dablink|For other uses of the words "black" and "rod," see [[Black]] and [[Rod]].}}
The '''flexible black rod''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' recovered from the [[Kin]]'s storeroom in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|2}}

==Appearance==
The ''ter'angreal'' is slim and black, stiff, yet flexible enough to be twisted into a circle before springing back again, as if it is made of rubber. It is no thicker than a little finger, and a pace in length.

==Use==
Not much is known about the rod other than it causes a person pain, the amount of which is adjustable. Supposedly, one blow from the rod can be made to feel like a hundred.{{ref/book|11|15}}
